name: Tyker Robot Plotter
summary: Self-propelled 21 kg marking robot that plots lines and points from DXF or CSV files with 1 to 2 cm accuracy, guided by GNSS or a total station. Dutch maker, used on roads, tunnels and building sites.

germany.statusNote: Tyker (Barneveld, Netherlands) has a sales line and a rental line; price is on request. Robots in Construction lists Flughafen Stuttgart GmbH among its customers.

sellers.note: Sales line; a separate rental line +31 (0)85 482 4813 is listed.
sellers.name: Tyker

specs.label: Plotting speed
specs.value: Up to 5 km/h, 300 points per hour
specs.quote: Plotting up to 5 km/h – 300 points per hour

specs.label: Surfaces
specs.quote: Asphalt, concrete, rubble, sand, grass, etc.

specs.label: Positioning
specs.value: Integrated GNSS receiver or total station
specs.quote: Controlled via (integrated) GNSS receiver or Total Station

notes: Marking modules: spray can, paint, drill, laser pointing.
Works on asphalt, concrete, rubble, sand and grass according to the maker.
Driven by remote control and tablet.
